# Carnival Glam Hub

Carnival Glam Hub is a premium Carnival morning concierge for travelling masqueraders in Trinidad, Jamaica, Miami, Toronto, Grenada (Spice Mas), Saint Lucia, Antigua, and Barbados (Crop Over). Founded 2017 by Gabrielle Waite. Trusted by 15,000+ masqueraders.

## Booking
Book at https://www.carnivalglamhub.com/#booking. Email bookings@carnivalglamhub.com.

## Core Pages
About https://www.carnivalglamhub.com/about. FAQ https://www.carnivalglamhub.com/faq. Blogs https://www.carnivalglamhub.com/blogs.
